name: sentinel
title: Sentinel
description: Every 30 minutes (07:00-23:30): carries out bin/sentinel-scan's plan, telling the maintainers once per event about critical issues, advisories, do-not-merge reviews, a red default branch, unreleased critical fixes and routine failures, and opening an issue when the default branch stays red.
notes: Telegram is optional: without it (bin/notify exit 3) messages still count as delivered and the desktop notification still fires. Settings in sentinel.json next to bin/ (labels, workflows that make the default branch red, alert patterns).
